description: Use when you need a public company's reported numbers without scraping filings: pulls the company's XBRL facts from SEC EDGAR and returns 13 standard metrics (US GAAP), each with the source concept, unit, the last 5 fiscal-year values and last 4 quarterly (3-month or point-in-time) values, with period dates, form, filing date and accession number for audit. Plus latest shares outstanding. Values are as filed (not adjusted). Paid tool: x402 USDC on Base, $0.004 per successful call; call without payment to receive the PaymentRequired object.
